description: A script providing a client implementation for Veo video generation via LiteLLM proxy, including methods for initiating generation, polling status, downloading results, and a main example usage.

classes.name: VeoVideoGenerator
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Veo video generation through LiteLLM proxy, including methods to generate videos, poll for status, download videos, and orchestrate the process.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str = "http://localhost:4000/gemini/v1beta", api_key: str = "sk-1234")
methods.description: Initializes the VeoVideoGenerator with base URL and API key, setting headers for requests.

methods.name: Optional[str] generate_video(self, prompt: str)
methods.description: Starts the video creation process with a specified prompt, returning an operation name if successful.

methods.name: Optional[str] wait_for_completion(self, operation_name: str, max_wait_time: int = 600)
methods.description: Polls the operation status until completion or timeout, returning the video URI on success.

methods.name: bool download_video(self, video_uri: str, output_filename: str = "generated_video.mp4")
methods.description: Downloads the generated video from Google's URI, saving it locally.

methods.name: bool generate_and_download(self, prompt: str, output_filename: str = None)
methods.description: End-to-end workflow: generate a video from prompt, wait for completion, and download it.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Example script demonstrating the use of VeoVideoGenerator.
